name: mdrift
description: A small, offline Markdown reader and editor for macOS

scripts.test: npm run test:editor && npm run test:finder
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run build:finder && ./scripts/package.sh
scripts.format: prettier --write 'src/*.js' src/web/index.html src/web/style.css scripts/build-web.mjs tests/editor.test.cjs README.md CONTRIBUTING.md THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md package.json .github/workflows/ci.yml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check 'src/*.js' src/web/index.html src/web/style.css scripts/build-web.mjs tests/editor.test.cjs README.md CONTRIBUTING.md THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md package.json .github/workflows/ci.yml
scripts.format:swift: xcrun swift-format format -i src/*.swift scripts/make-icon.swift tests/NativeTests.swift
scripts.format:swift:check: xcrun swift-format lint --strict src/*.swift scripts/make-icon.swift tests/NativeTests.swift
